name: Nicolás Pascual de la Parte - § 18 - Am 137
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 18. Notes that Ukraine’s territorial disputes with Russia are likely to persist, even if peace talks succeed; reiterates that Ukraine’s integration in NATO would pose a significant security risk, as unresolved territorial disputes could create challenges regarding the application of Article 5; stresses that the demilitarisation of Ukraine is equally unfair, as it would undermine its sovereign right to self-defence;
